folds.text: Each Claude Code session starts with a fresh context window. A **CLAUDE.md** file is a note you write once so Claude reads your standing instructions every session.
It can live in your project folder, shared with your team, or in your own home folder for every project. A private local version is just for you.
Good contents: how to run and test the project, your conventions, and things Claude could not guess. Run `/init` to get a starter file, then refine it.
Keep it short and specific. Aim for under 200 lines, because longer files use more context and Claude follows them less reliably.
Claude treats CLAUDE.md as guidance, not a hard rule. To block an action for certain, use a hook instead. Claude also writes its own notes, called **auto memory**.

folds.prompt: Does it belong in CLAUDE.md? Tap the basket.
